headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for WLED - control your WLED-powered LED strips through HomeKit
footerDisplay: For more information, see the [WLED website](https://kno.wled.ge/) and [GitHub repository](https://github.com/esadrian/homebridge-wled-kit).

logLevel.title: Log Level
logLevel.description: Set the logging level for the plugin. Debug mode provides detailed information for troubleshooting.

autoDiscover.title: Automatically Discover WLED Devices (Deprecated)
autoDiscover.description: This setting is no longer used. Device discovery is now only triggered manually through the Custom Plugin UI to reduce network scanning.

defaultUsePresetService.title: Add Preset Controls
defaultUsePresetService.description: Create preset control accessory for automatically discovered devices

defaultUseWebSockets.title: Use WebSockets
defaultUseWebSockets.description: Use WebSockets for real-time updates on automatically discovered devices (requires WLED v0.13+)

autoStopDiscoveryWhenAllConfigured.title: Auto-stop Discovery When All Found Devices Are Configured
autoStopDiscoveryWhenAllConfigured.description: When using the Custom UI's discovery tab, automatically stop discovery once all discovered devices are already in your config.

tvNameSuffix.title: TV Accessory Name Suffix
tvNameSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the TV/preset accessory name (when using the separate TV accessory mode).

customInputLabel.title: Custom Input Label
customInputLabel.description: Label used for the manual/no-preset input (Identifier 0) in the TV input list.

nightlight.title: Global Nightlight Defaults
nightlight.description: Optional default nightlight configuration applied to devices that do not define their own nightlight settings.

enabled.title: Enable Nightlight By Default
enabled.description: If enabled, devices without their own nightlight settings will get nightlight timer accessories using these defaults.

timers.title: Default Nightlight Timers
timers.description: List of timers available for nightlight mode. Each timer becomes a separate switch accessory control.

name.title: Timer Name
name.description: Label for this timer, e.g. '5 min'.

seconds.title: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: Duration of this timer in seconds.

devices.title: Manually Configured WLED Devices
devices.description: Manually add WLED devices that cannot be auto-discovered or require custom settings

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable or disable this device without removing it from configuration

firmwareVersion.title: Firmware Version
firmwareVersion.description: WLED firmware version reported by the device (set automatically when adding via discovery)

nightlight.title: Nightlight
nightlight.description: Per-device nightlight settings. If enabled, this device gets a separate nightlight accessory with one switch per timer.

enabled.title: Enable Nightlight
enabled.description: Enable nightlight/timer accessory for this device.

timers.title: Nightlight Timers
timers.description: List of timers available for nightlight mode. Each timer becomes a separate switch on the nightlight accessory.

name.title: Timer Name
name.description: Label for this timer, e.g. '5 min'.

seconds.title: Duration (seconds)
seconds.description: Duration of this timer in seconds.

usePresetService.title: Add Preset Controls
usePresetService.description: Create preset control accessory for this device

singleAccessoryWithTV.title: Single Accessory (TV Inputs)
singleAccessoryWithTV.description: Expose Light + Presets (TV input selector) as a single HomeKit accessory. Requires Homebridge restart and may require removing/re-adding accessories in the Home app due to HomeKit caching.

useWebSockets.title: Use WebSockets
useWebSockets.description: Use WebSockets for real-time updates (requires WLED v0.13+)

enabledPresets.title: Enabled Presets
enabledPresets.description: List of preset IDs that are enabled for this device. Configure this in the Custom Plugin UI.
